What to check or set: The plain name buyers search for: what it is plus one key detail.
Rule: Short and clear. No CAPITALS or emoji. Same style as your other products.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Speckled Stoneware Mug, 350 ml

What to check or set: Hook, 3 benefits, specs with real numbers, care, short FAQ. See section 7.
Rule: Only true facts. Numbers, not words like large or fast.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Hook, 3 benefits, 350 ml, 9.5 cm tall, stoneware, dishwasher safe, 3 FAQs

What to check or set: Main photo plus the shots buyers need: scale, detail, in use, packaging. See section 8.
Rule: At least 5 photos. Same light and background. Every photo has alt text.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): 8 photos: main, second angle, in hand, glaze close-up, base, on table, box, colours

Where in Shopify admin: Variants > Add options like size or color
What to check or set: Option name and its values. Use the same spelling as on your other products.
Rule: Only options you can really ship.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Option: Color. Values: Sage Green, Sand, Charcoal

What to check or set: Each variant has its own price, SKU, stock, weight and photo.
Rule: Open every variant. Do not check only the first one.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): 3 of 3 variants complete

Where in Shopify admin: Variants > click the photo icon next to the variant
What to check or set: Link the right photo, so buyers see the colour they pick.
Rule: One photo per variant at least.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Each colour shows its own main photo

What to check or set: The price buyers pay for this variant.
Rule: Check every variant. Check your tax settings to see if prices include tax.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): 24.00 for all 3 colours

What to check or set: Only a real earlier price, and only if it was higher. Otherwise leave it blank.
Rule: In the EU the earlier price you show must be the lowest price of the last 30 days.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Blank (no real earlier price)

Where in Shopify admin: Pricing > Charge tax on this product
What to check or set: Ticked for most physical products. Check Settings > Taxes and duties.
Rule: Ask a tax adviser if you are not sure.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Ticked

What to check or set: What one unit costs you. Buyers never see it. Shopify then shows profit and margin.
Rule: Include the item and its packaging.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): 9.50 (Shopify shows profit 14.50, margin 60.4%)

What to check or set: Your own short code for each variant.
Rule: Unique per variant. Letters, numbers and dashes.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): FM-MUG350-SAGE, FM-MUG350-SAND, FM-MUG350-CHAR

What to check or set: The real barcode number from the packaging, if there is one.
Rule: Never make one up. Handmade items often have none.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): None (handmade)

What to check or set: Ticked, then enter the stock you really have at each location.
Rule: Count before you go live.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Ticked. Sage Green 12, Sand 8, Charcoal 5

Check: Continue selling when out of stock
Where in Shopify admin: Inventory > Continue selling when out of stock
What to check or set: Off, so you never sell what you do not have.
Rule: Turn it on only for made to order items, and show the real delivery time on the page.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Off

Where in Shopify admin: Shipping > This is a physical product
What to check or set: Ticked for anything you post.
Rule: Untick only for digital products or services.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Ticked

What to check or set: Weigh one unit packed, with its box and filling.
Rule: Round up. Wrong weight gives wrong shipping rates at checkout.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): 0.55 kg packed

What to check or set: The product is in a shipping profile with rates for every country you sell to.
Rule: Buyers in a country with no rate cannot check out.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): General profile. Rates for home country and EU

What to check or set: Country or region of origin and HS code, if you ship abroad.
Rule: Check the HS code with your carrier or the customs tariff. Do not guess.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Origin: Portugal. HS code: 6912.00 (ceramic tableware, not porcelain)

Check: SEO title, meta description, URL handle
What to check or set: Fill all three. Full rules in section 10.
Rule: SEO title about 60 characters. Meta description about 155.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Speckled Stoneware Mug, 350 ml, Sage Green | Fernmoor

Where in Shopify admin: Media > click each photo > Alt text
What to check or set: Say what is in each photo in plain words.
Rule: About 125 characters or less. No keyword lists.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Fernmoor speckled stoneware mug in sage green on a wooden table

Where in Shopify admin: Product page > Category and Product organization
What to check or set: Pick the exact category, same spelling for type and vendor, 1 to 3 collections, 3 to 8 tags.
Rule: See section 10 for each field.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Mugs / Mug / Fernmoor / Ceramic Mugs / stoneware, handmade, gift idea

What to check or set: Draft while you work. Active only after the final test.
Rule: Draft products are hidden from buyers.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Draft, then Active after steps 25 and 26

What to check or set: Online Store ticked, plus every other channel you use. Check the markets you sell to.
Rule: A product that is Active but not on Online Store does not show in your shop.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Online Store and Shop. Markets: home country and EU

What to check or set: The right product template, if your theme has more than one.
Rule: The template decides which sections show, for example the FAQ block.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Default product

Where in Shopify admin: View the live page on a phone
What to check or set: Click every variant: photo, price and stock message change. Read all text for typos.
Rule: Fix anything that looks wrong, then check again.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): All 3 colours switch photo and price

Where in Shopify admin: Live page > Add to cart > Checkout
What to check or set: Go to checkout with a test address. Check shipping rate, tax and total before the payment step.
Rule: For a full test order, use your payment provider's test mode, then cancel the test order.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Sage Green to cart, shipping and tax shown correctly
